messages:
Harper: Quick creative request for the benchmark webinar next Tue. Need a tight deliverable set: hero (1200x628) + email banner (600x200), 4 social microcards (1080x1080), an explainer slide (16:9, SVG), and a gated benchmark one-pager (A4 + mobile 800x1200). Prefer modular Figma components so product can swap numbers. Deadline: comps Mon AM.
Diego: I can take lead on visual direction. Two messaging lanes: "Developer-focused" (fast, low-cost) and "Enterprise" (SLA & predictable throughput). Which gets priority?
Harper: Both, but dev lane first for social. Keep microcards <=12 words. Include short alt text lines.
Anika: For the explainer slide, let's show cost/token on Y and latency on X with a shaded p50-p95 band. Make the graph exportable as SVG so Alex can animate the band in keynote. Also include a tiny config footnote (model, seq len, GPU).
Sam: Routing/CTAs: hero needs [Register] -> /events?utm_source=web&utm_campaign=bench_may and [Get benchmark] -> gated form. Gated form should collect name/company/email/role and include hidden_campaign=bench_may_2026. Also include a Calendly link for enterprise leads.
design-bot: Brand assets: https://drive.redwood/brand/latest - color tokens, typescale, logo lockups. Auto-check: hero safe zone = 48px. Suggested export names: bench_web_hero_1200x628.png, bench_onepager_A4.pdf, bench_tile_1080x1080_v1.png.
Anika: Accessibility note: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for body text and provide alt text in the Figma file. Microcards should have clear focal points for center-crop.
legal-bot: Reminder: any benchmark claim must include a footnote: "Based on internal Redwood Inference testing; results may vary by workload." No competitor logos or product names. GDPR consent required on gated asset.
Diego: Timeline: wireframes today, first comps Mon 9am, final exports Tue morning. I'll post a Figma link when frames are up.
Harper: Also need localized copy EN/DE/FR. I'll drop the translations by Sun EOD.
Sam: I'll provide the sample CSV of numbers and the exact UTMs by tonight.
Anika: Will design SVG + PNG fallbacks and a compact table component for the one-pager. Will add Lottie-friendly layers for the animated band.
Diego: Uploading wireframes to Figma now (figma.com/file/benchpack2026). Tagging @Harper for copy placement.
Harper: Thanks! Please ping here when WIP is ready. Also include an email-safe dark variant for the banner. :thumbsup:
